items.title: Hot US CPI (+0.4%) lifts odds of half-point Fed hike in December; Bitcoin falls
items.excerpt: Stronger-than-expected October inflation raises odds of a bigger December Fed hike, pressuring Bitcoin and BTC-linked risk assets.

items.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as spot ETF outflows mount and MARA sells BTC
items.excerpt: BTC diverged from a stock rebound as US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows continued and miner MARA reduced its holdings.

items.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
items.excerpt: LNbits shipped an emergency fix after reports of stolen Bitcoin from Lightning wallets; users should update.

items.title: Bitcoin faces US CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
